features.title: 🚀 Merchant can view settlement status for a completed payment
features.body:
## User Stories

### Story: Merchant sees settlement status
As a Merchant, I want to see the settlement status of a completed payment, so that I can track my payout.

```gherkin
Scenario: Status shown for a settled payment
  Given a Merchant has a completed payment that is settled
  When the Merchant opens the payment detail page
  Then the settlement status 'Settled' is shown
```

## Trace Plan

1. [ ] ☄️ Skeleton — Merchant sees settlement status for one completed payment (claims: "Status shown for a settled payment")
